### Summary

Envoy versions v1.39.2, v1.38.5, v1.37.7 and v1.36.11 are vulnerable to a buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder.

### Details

A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decompressor in Envoy v1.39.2, v1.38.5, v1.37.7 and v1.36.11 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream. This vulnerability was addressed in Envoy v1.40.0, v1.39.3, v1.38.6, v1.37.8 and v1.36.12.

Brotli vulnerability was published under [CVE-2026-111497](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-111497)

### Impact

Envoy deployments that have Brotli decompressor configured.
